q: In HoTT, the fundamental groupoid of a type X has as objects the terms of X and as morphisms:
opts: The identity proofs (paths) p: x = y for x, y : X
exp: In HoTT, the type x =_X y of identity proofs behaves as a path space. The collection of all terms and all identity proofs forms the fundamental groupoid of X, and higher identities between paths give the ∞-groupoid structure (the homotopy type of X).
